title: Representative rear brake drum mount, pivot and fastener semantics
inputs: Place the loose drum into the 0.01 m collider-overlap candidate
Use wrench 14 for one full 0..8 progression and reverse progression
Attempt removal with and without the rear-left wheel installed
expected: Three identical install/remove outcomes with the wheel absent
One BoltPM marker reaches and leaves the 0/8 completion gates
Wheel-installed state blocks removal; wheel-absent unfastened state allows removal
toleranceNotes: Transform evidence targets 5 mm. Three clean install/forward/reverse/remove repetitions and the discrete fastener contract are validated. The donor candidate uses collider overlap and has no separate angular compare; remake orientation tolerance is project-authored tuning.
